tools.name: get_element
tools.description: Everything the Interactive Periodic Table knows about one element: classification, physical and chemical properties with units, electron configuration, discovery, a short summary and a longer introduction (uses, production, history, safety), plus the link to its page.

tools.name: search_elements
tools.description: Find elements by symbol, atomic number, or full or partial name in any supported language. Use it when a name is misspelled, partial or in another language.

tools.name: list_elements
tools.description: List elements, optionally filtered by category, block, period, group, state at 25 °C or a numeric property range, and sorted by a property. Without filters it lists all 118 elements in atomic-number order. Elements with no value for the range or sort property are left out.

tools.name: compare_elements
tools.description: Side-by-side numeric properties of 2-10 elements, with units.
